title: Roasted Delicata Squash with Quinoa Salad, Seeds and Tzfatit Cheese
subtitle: stuffed with a warm quinoa and sprout salad
description: Roasted delicata squash halves filled with a quinoa salad of carrot, seeds, cranberries, sunflower sprouts and soft tzfatit cheese. Mix the salad with the quinoa while it is still warm so the flavours soak in.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 180°C and line a baking tray with baking paper.
Place the squash halves on the tray, season with pepper, thyme leaves and half the crushed garlic and drizzle with 1 to 2 tablespoons olive oil.
Roast for 30 to 40 minutes until the squash is soft and golden.
Cook the quinoa in plenty of boiling water, like pasta, for 12 to 15 minutes until translucent and tender.
Transfer the quinoa to a bowl and, while it is hot, add the finely grated carrot and the remaining olive oil and garlic. Cool and fluff with a fork.
Add the cheese cut into small triangles, the seeds, cranberries, sprouts, lemon juice and honey and mix.
Fill the squash halves with the salad and serve while the squash is warm or at room temperature.
